stem:
Fig. 1.1**A** is a photomicrograph of healthy lung tissue.

Fig. 1.1**B** is a photomicrograph of lung tissue from a person with emphysema, a chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). The images are both at magnification $\times 40$.

{{figure:figure_1_1.png}}

Fig. 1.1

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Name the structure labelled **H** in Fig. 1.1**A**.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Calculate the actual diameter of the alveolus at **X-Y**.

Write down the formula and use it to make your calculation.

Give your answer to the nearest whole micrometre ($\mu\text{m}$).

{{figure:reviewed_response_1.png}}

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Gas exchange in the lungs occurs in the alveoli.

Describe the process of gas exchange in healthy lungs **and** suggest how this compares with gas exchange in the diseased lung shown in Fig. 1.1**B**.
